name: source-code-mgmt
description: DSH plugin: source code management. Registers「代码管理」as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar Tab when installed; otherwise registers a button in the DSH session header's right-aligned utilities (beside "Session log"), with an empty-state entry pinned at the TOP-RIGHT at the SAME HEIGHT as that button (top: 9px, derived from the header's own padding/title-row metrics, plus the desktop titlebar offset) and inset 48px so it clears the right-sidebar expand button. The two entries are mutually exclusive, and nothing is ever placed in DSH's own left sidebar. The SSH section lets you choose port 443 (through firewalls that block 22) or the standard 22, and switching rewrites ~/.ssh/config in place. Repo status batches its git calls (one numstat for all changed files, one `remote -v` for name+URL), cutting a load on a busy repo from ~1.3s to ~0.06s. Opens a right-side integrated panel that pushes the main content — env checks (git/gh), SSH ed25519 key setup, GitHub/Gitee dual-platform (SSH config + Gitee OpenAPI), connectivity test, push / new repo, auto-ignore files over 100MB with per-file skipped reasons, a clone section (remote repos from your account with local-exists detection, plus clone any repo by URL into any location), and a five-step npm publish wizard. Cross-platform (Windows / Linux / macOS).
